description: This Java class defines the GroupServiceModel, which encapsulates the properties and invocation logic for a grouped service in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes constructors, getters, and an invoke method to execute the service synchronously or asynchronously based on configuration.

classes.name: GroupServiceModel
classes.description: Represents a service model with properties such as name, mode, and flags for result handling and optional parameters. Provides methods to invoke the service and generate string representation.

methods.name: GroupServiceModel(Element service)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service model from an XML DOM element, extracting attributes for name, mode, result-to-context, and optional parameters.

methods.name: GroupServiceModel(String serviceName, String serviceMode)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service model with specified name and mode.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the invocation mode of the service ('sync' or 'async').

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service.

methods.name: resultToContext
methods.description: Indicates whether the service results should be returned into the context.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Indicates whether the service parameters are optional.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes the service via the dispatcher, choosing between synchronous and asynchronous execution based on the mode and required output parameters.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the service model, including name and mode.
